userVisible: Anyone can read and contribute to this repository: nothing in it points at a private plan or at one person's machine.

Two writers who prepared a change against the same version cannot both store it, a commit stores exactly the model that was proposed, and a clone is exactly the version it names: the model of these rules passes the model checker, and every deliberately broken copy is caught.

Every command answers the way every Ambitious module does: one JSON answer, fixed exit codes, repeatable output, no access to the bot's private data, and analysis that never changes data. This holds on a computer where the solver runtime was never installed.
check: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/build.py && node scripts/py.mjs -m ambitious_kit.contract dist/ambitious-constraints.pyz

userVisible: On a fresh computer the kit installer puts the module and its pinned solver runtime in place, selfcheck reports both as ready, and a bot can propose a model, commit it after approval, see the smallest set of goals that cannot all hold and the smallest thing to give up, solve a scenario, sweep an assumption, compare scenarios and record the run.

Without the solver runtime the module still checks itself, validates, proposes, commits, clones and shows models, and every solving command says in plain words that the runtime is missing and how to install it.
check: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/build.py && node scripts/py.mjs -m unittest tests.test_cli.WithoutTheRuntime

userVisible: A proposal stores nothing. A commit changes only the model it names, only from the version it was prepared against, and only the exact model that was proposed.
